annotations.title: Make a project public or private

description: Make a project of the person's public, or private again. public=true: ANYONE can then open the project, its documents (INCLUDING THE PERSON'S OWN UPLOADED PDFs in it) and its answers, through the returned link and on GeoThought's public pages; allow_ask lets visitors ask it questions. public=false: private again, and the link stops working. Only do this when the person asked for it, and ALWAYS tell them what the result's tell_user says.
name: geothought_publish_project
title: Make a project public or private
